summary: Marked angled bays on a quiet bend, with apartments about 18 m across the road.
reasons: Angled bays with cars already parked

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 16-18 m across the road to the north, houses 22-30 m to the south; bush behind the bays on the west side.
drivers.access_and_room: Off-street angled bays beside the lane; cars fit, room for a van is plausible but bays look car-sized.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential bend; little through traffic seen.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the bays, so a van blends in a little; no campers seen.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign near the 45 m end; stay west of it
Mean grade 3% over the stretch, about 1% at best section
sun_shade: Open to sun mostly; trees shade the west end and the south edge in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Angled parking bays on the south side of the bend, west of the sign
